residue

cjr.examples.hash_map.residue

definition residue:
    parameter(k, cap, type(Z))
    type:
        Z
    body:
        let:
            r
            Z.rem(k, cap)
            if_then_else:
                decide(in_scope Z(less_than(r, 0)))
                in_scope Z(add(r, cap))
                r
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition residue (k cap : Z) : Z :=
  let r := Z.rem k cap in
  if decide (r < 0)%Z then (r + cap)%Z else r.

Lemma residue_spec k cap :
  (0 < cap)%Z →
  (0 ≤ residue k cap < cap)%Z ∧ residue k cap = Z.modulo k cap.

Lemma probe_slot_sub start step cap :
  (0 < cap)%nat → (start < cap)%nat → (step < cap)%nat →
  probe_slot start step cap =
    (if decide ((start + step) < cap)%nat then start + step
     else start + step - cap)%nat.

contents_of

cjr.examples.hash_map.contents_of

recursive function contents_of:
    parameter(tags, keys, vals, type(list(Z)))
    type:
        gmap(Z, Z)
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            tags
            keys
            vals
            case:
                patterns(cons(t, tags), cons(k, keys), cons(v, vals))
                let:
                    m
                    contents_of(tags, keys, vals)
                    if_then_else:
                        decide(equals(t, tag_occ))
                        apply:
                            notation "<[ _ := _ ]>":
                                k
                                v
                            m
                        m
            case:
                patterns(_, _, _)
                notation "∅"
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint contents_of (tags keys vals : list Z) : gmap Z Z :=
  match tags, keys, vals with
  | t :: tags, k :: keys, v :: vals =>
      let m := contents_of tags keys vals in
      if decide (t = tag_occ) then <[k := v]> m else m
  | _, _, _ => ∅
  end.

Fixpoint occ_keys (tags keys : list Z) : list Z :=
  match tags, keys with
  | t :: tags, k :: keys =>
      if decide (t = tag_occ) then k :: occ_keys tags keys else occ_keys tags keys
  | _, _ => []
  end.

count_occ

cjr.examples.hash_map.count_occ

recursive function count_occ:
    parameter(tags, type(list(Z)))
    type:
        nat
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            tags
            case:
                patterns(empty_list)
                0
            case:
                patterns(cons(t, tags))
                add:
                    if_then_else:
                        decide(equals(t, tag_occ))
                        1
                        0
                    count_occ(tags)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint count_occ (tags : list Z) : nat :=
  match tags with
  | [] => 0
  | t :: tags =>
      (if decide (t = tag_occ) then 1 else 0) + count_occ tags
  end.

occ_unique

cjr.examples.hash_map.occ_unique

lemma occ_unique:
    parameter(tags, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(keys, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(i, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(j, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(k, type(_ (inferred)))
    statement:
        arrow:
            NoDup(occ_keys(tags, keys))
            arrow:
                equals(lookup(tags, i), Some(tag_occ))
                arrow:

                    arrow:
                        equals(lookup(tags, j), Some(tag_occ))
                        arrow(equals(lookup(keys, j), Some(k)), equals(i, j))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma occ_unique tags keys i j k :
  NoDup (occ_keys tags keys) →
  tags !! i = Some tag_occ → keys !! i = Some k →
  tags !! j = Some tag_occ → keys !! j = Some k →
  i = j.

lemma contents_none_iff:

Lemma contents_none_iff tags keys vals k :
  length keys = length tags → length vals = length tags →
  contents_of tags keys vals !! k = None ↔ k ∉ occ_keys tags keys.

Lemma contents_at tags keys vals i k v :
  length keys = length tags → length vals = length tags →
  NoDup (occ_keys tags keys) →
  tags !! i = Some tag_occ → keys !! i = Some k → vals !! i = Some v →
  contents_of tags keys vals !! k = Some v.

  match step with
  | 0 => None
  | S step =>

      | Some h => Some h
      | None =>
          match tags !! probe_slot start step cap with
          | Some t =>

          | None => None

probe_from

cjr.examples.hash_map.probe_from

recursive function probe_from:
    parameter(n, start, step, cap, type(nat))
    parameter(tags, keys, vals, type(list(Z)))
    parameter(k, type(Z))
    parameter(hole, type(option(nat)))
    type:
        probe_out
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            n
            case:
                patterns(0)
                PAbsent(hole_or(hole, start))
            case:
                patterns(S(n))
                let:
                    s
                    probe_slot(start, step, cap)
                    match RegularStyle:
                        lookup(tags, s)
                        case:
                            patterns(None)
                            PAbsent(hole_or(hole, s))
                        case:
                            patterns(Some(t))
                            if_then_else:
                                decide(equals(t, tag_empty))
                                PAbsent(hole_or(hole, s))
                                if_then_else:
                                    decide(equals(t, tag_occ))
                                    match RegularStyle:
                                        lookup(keys, s)
                                        lookup(vals, s)
                                        case:
                                            patterns(Some(key), Some(v))
                                            if_then_else:
                                                decide(equals(key, k))
                                                PFound(s, v)
                                                probe_from:
                                                    n
                                                    start
                                                    S(step)
                                                    cap
                                                    tags
                                                    keys
                                                    vals
                                                    k
                                                    hole
                                        case:
                                            patterns(_, _)
                                            PAbsent(hole_or(hole, s))
                                    let:
                                        hole'
                                        match RegularStyle:
                                            hole
                                            case:
                                                patterns(None)
                                                Some(s)
                                            case:
                                                patterns(Some(_))
                                                hole
                                        probe_from:
                                            n
                                            start
                                            S(step)
                                            cap
                                            tags
                                            keys
                                            vals
                                            k
                                            hole'
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint probe_from (n start step cap : nat) (tags keys vals : list Z)
    (k : Z) (hole : option nat) : probe_out :=
  match n with
  | 0 => PAbsent (hole_or hole start)
  | S n =>
      let s := probe_slot start step cap in
      match tags !! s with
      | None => PAbsent (hole_or hole s)
      | Some t =>
          if decide (t = tag_empty) then PAbsent (hole_or hole s)
          else if decide (t = tag_occ) then
            match keys !! s, vals !! s with
            | Some key, Some v =>
                if decide (key = k) then PFound s v
                else probe_from n start (S step) cap tags keys vals k hole
            | _, _ => PAbsent (hole_or hole s)
            end
          else
            let hole' := match hole with None => Some s | Some _ => hole end in
            probe_from n start (S step) cap tags keys vals k hole'
      end
  end.

Lemma probe_from_inv n start step cap tags keys vals k hole :
  (0 < cap)%nat → (start < cap)%nat →
  (step + n = cap)%nat →
  length tags = cap → length keys = cap → length vals = cap →
  tags_ok tags → (count_occ tags < cap)%nat →
  probe_prefix cap start step tags keys k hole →
  match probe_from n start step cap tags keys vals k hole with
  | PFound idx v =>
      (idx < cap)%nat ∧ tags !! idx = Some tag_occ ∧
      keys !! idx = Some k ∧ vals !! idx = Some v ∧
      no_empty_before cap start idx tags
  | PAbsent idx =>
      (idx < cap)%nat ∧
      (tags !! idx = Some tag_empty ∨ tags !! idx = Some tag_tomb) ∧
      no_empty_before cap start idx tags
  end.

cjr.examples.hash_map.probe_shape

lemma probe_shape:
    parameter(cap, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(tags, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(keys, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(vals, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(k, type(_ (inferred)))

                                arrow:
                                    placed(cap, tags, keys)
                                    arrow:
                                        in_scope nat(less_than(count_occ(tags), cap))
                                        match RegularStyle:
                                            probe(cap, bucket(k, cap), tags, keys, vals, k)
                                            case:
                                                patterns(PFound(idx, v))
                                                equals:
                                                    lookup(contents_of(tags, keys, vals), k)
                                                    Some(v)
                                            case:
                                                patterns(PAbsent(idx))
                                                both:
                                                    in_scope nat(less_than(idx, cap))
                                                    both:
                                                        either:
                                                            equals:
                                                                lookup(tags, idx)
                                                                Some(tag_empty)
                                                            equals:
                                                                lookup(tags, idx)
                                                                Some(tag_tomb)
                                                        both:
                                                            no_empty_before:
                                                                cap
                                                                bucket(k, cap)
                                                                idx
                                                                tags
                                                            equals:
                                                                lookup:
                                                                    contents_of:
                                                                        tags
                                                                        keys
                                                                        vals
                                                                    k
                                                                None
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma probe_shape cap tags keys vals k :
  (0 < cap)%nat →
  length tags = cap → length keys = cap → length vals = cap →
  tags_ok tags → NoDup (occ_keys tags keys) → placed cap tags keys →
  (count_occ tags < cap)%nat →
  match probe cap (bucket k cap) tags keys vals k with
  | PFound idx v => contents_of tags keys vals !! k = Some v
  | PAbsent idx =>
      (idx < cap)%nat ∧
      (tags !! idx = Some tag_empty ∨ tags !! idx = Some tag_tomb) ∧
      no_empty_before cap (bucket k cap) idx tags ∧
      contents_of tags keys vals !! k = None
  end.

wf_table

cjr.examples.hash_map.wf_table

record wf_table:
    parameter(cap, type(nat))
    parameter(tags, keys, vals, type(list(Z)))
    statement:
        Prop
    Wf
    wf_tags_len(equals(length(tags), cap))
    wf_keys_len(equals(length(keys), cap))
    wf_vals_len(equals(length(vals), cap))
    wf_pow:
        exists:
            binders:
                parameter(e, type(_ (inferred)))
            equals:
                cap
                in_scope nat:
                    notation "_ ^ _":
                        2
                        S(e)
    wf_ok(tags_ok(tags))
    wf_dup(NoDup(occ_keys(tags, keys)))
    wf_load(in_scope nat(less_or_equal(multiply(2, count_occ(tags)), cap)))
    wf_place(placed(cap, tags, keys))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Record wf_table (cap : nat) (tags keys vals : list Z) : Prop := Wf {
  wf_tags_len : length tags = cap;
  wf_keys_len : length keys = cap;
  wf_vals_len : length vals = cap;
  wf_pow : ∃ e, cap = (2 ^ S e)%nat;
  wf_ok : tags_ok tags;
  wf_dup : NoDup (occ_keys tags keys);
  wf_load : (2 * count_occ tags ≤ cap)%nat;
  wf_place : placed cap tags keys

definition write_fresh:

  | PAbsent idx => place_slot tags keys vals idx k v

rehash_acc

cjr.examples.hash_map.rehash_acc

recursive function rehash_acc:
    parameter(cap, type(nat))
    parameter(tags, keys, vals, accT, accK, accV, type(list(Z)))
    type:
        product_type(product_type(list(Z), list(Z)), list(Z))
    body:
        match RegularStyle:
            tags
            keys
            vals
            case:
                patterns(cons(t, tags), cons(k, keys), cons(v, vals))
                if_then_else:
                    decide(equals(t, tag_occ))
                    match LetPatternStyle:
                        write_fresh(cap, accT, accK, accV, k, v)
                        case:
                            patterns(tuple_with_tail_items(a, items(b, c)))
                            rehash_acc(cap, tags, keys, vals, a, b, c)
                    rehash_acc(cap, tags, keys, vals, accT, accK, accV)
            case:
                patterns(_, _, _)
                tuple_with_tail_items(accT, items(accK, accV))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Fixpoint rehash_acc (cap : nat) (tags keys vals accT accK accV : list Z)
    : list Z * list Z * list Z :=
  match tags, keys, vals with
  | t :: tags, k :: keys, v :: vals =>
      if decide (t = tag_occ) then
        let '(a, b, c) := write_fresh cap accT accK accV k v in
        rehash_acc cap tags keys vals a b c
      else rehash_acc cap tags keys vals accT accK accV
  | _, _, _ => (accT, accK, accV)
  end.

cjr.examples.hash_map.rehash_acc_lookup

lemma rehash_acc_lookup:
    parameter(cap, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(tags, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(keys, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(vals, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(accT, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(accK, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(accV, type(_ (inferred)))
    statement:
        arrow:
            wf_table(cap, accT, accK, accV)
            arrow:
                equals(length(keys), length(tags))
                arrow:
                    equals(length(vals), length(tags))
                    arrow:
                        tags_ok(tags)
                        arrow:
                            NoDup(occ_keys(tags, keys))
                            arrow:
                                forall:
                                    binders:
                                        parameter(x, type(_ (inferred)))
                                    arrow:
                                        notation "_ ∈ _":
                                            x
                                            occ_keys(tags, keys)
                                        equals:
                                            lookup(contents_of(accT, accK, accV), x)
                                            None
                                arrow:
                                    in_scope nat:
                                        less_or_equal:
                                            multiply:
                                                2
                                                add(count_occ(accT), count_occ(tags))
                                            cap
                                    match RegularStyle:
                                        rehash_acc(cap, tags, keys, vals, accT, accK, accV)
                                        case:
                                            patterns:
                                                tuple_with_tail_items(t2, items(k2, v2))
                                            both:
                                                wf_table(cap, t2, k2, v2)
                                                forall:
                                                    binders:
                                                        parameter(x, type(_ (inferred)))
                                                    equals:
                                                        lookup(contents_of(t2, k2, v2), x)
                                                        match RegularStyle:
                                                            lookup:
                                                                contents_of:
                                                                    tags
                                                                    keys
                                                                    vals
                                                                x
                                                            case:
                                                                patterns(Some(w))
                                                                Some(w)
                                                            case:
                                                                patterns(None)
                                                                lookup:
                                                                    contents_of:
                                                                        accT
                                                                        accK
                                                                        accV
                                                                    x
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma rehash_acc_lookup cap tags keys vals accT accK accV :
  wf_table cap accT accK accV →
  length keys = length tags → length vals = length tags →
  tags_ok tags → NoDup (occ_keys tags keys) →
  (∀ x, x ∈ occ_keys tags keys → contents_of accT accK accV !! x = None) →
  (2 * (count_occ accT + count_occ tags) ≤ cap)%nat →
  match rehash_acc cap tags keys vals accT accK accV with
  | (t2, k2, v2) =>
      wf_table cap t2 k2 v2 ∧
      ∀ x, contents_of t2 k2 v2 !! x =
        match contents_of tags keys vals !! x with
        | Some w => Some w
        | None => contents_of accT accK accV !! x
        end
  end.

      (ta ka va : val_cjr) : iProp Σ :=

    ⌜ length tags = cap ⌝ ∗ ⌜ length keys = cap ⌝ ∗ ⌜ length vals = cap ⌝ ∗
    ⌜ wf_table cap tags keys vals ⌝.

is_hashmap

cjr.examples.hash_map.is_hashmap · hash_map

definition is_hashmap:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(m, type(gmap(Z, Z)))
    parameter(cap, type(nat))
    parameter(a, type(val_cjr))
    type:
        iProp(Σ)
    body:
        exists:
            binders:
                parameter(o, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(sz, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(ta, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(ka, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(va, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(tags, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(keys, type(_ (inferred)))
                parameter(vals, type(_ (inferred)))
            separately:
                pure(equals(a, LitV(LitObj(o))))
                separately:
                    pure(equals(contents_of(tags, keys, vals), m))
                    separately:
                        pure(equals(sz, Z.of_nat(count_occ(tags))))
                        separately:
                            owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 0, LitV(LitInt(sz)))
                            separately:
                                owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 1, ta)
                                separately:
                                    owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 2, ka)
                                    separately:
                                        owns_object_field(ObjId(o), 3, va)
                                        is_hm_slots(cap, tags, keys, vals, ta, ka, va)
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition is_hashmap (m : gmap Z Z) (cap : nat) (a : val_cjr) : iProp Σ :=
    ∃ o sz ta ka va tags keys vals,
      ⌜ a = LitV (LitObj o) ⌝ ∗
      ⌜ contents_of tags keys vals = m ⌝ ∗
      ⌜ sz = Z.of_nat (count_occ tags) ⌝ ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[0] LitV (LitInt sz) ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[1] ta ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[2] ka ∗
      ObjId o ↦ₒ[3] va ∗
      is_hm_slots cap tags keys vals ta ka va.

definition scan_loop:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    type:
        expr
    body:
        conditional:
            BinOp(LeOp, Var("fuel"), Val(LitV(LitInt(0))))
            probe_done:
                Val(LitV(LitBool(false)))
                hole_or_e(Var("hole"), Var("start"))
                Val(LitV(LitInt(0)))
            let_binding:
                Some("slot")
                probe_slot_e(Var("start"), Var("step"), Var("cap"))
                let_binding:
                    Some("tag")
                    arr_get(Var("tags"), Var("slot"))
                    conditional:
                        BinOp(EqOp, Var("tag"), lit_tag_empty)
                        probe_done:
                            Val(LitV(LitBool(false)))
                            hole_or_e(Var("hole"), Var("slot"))
                            Val(LitV(LitInt(0)))
                        conditional:
                            BinOp(EqOp, Var("tag"), lit_tag_occ)
                            let_binding:
                                Some("key")
                                arr_get(Var("keys"), Var("slot"))
                                conditional:
                                    BinOp(EqOp, Var("key"), Var("k"))
                                    probe_done:
                                        Val(LitV(LitBool(true)))
                                        Var("slot")
                                        arr_get(Var("vals"), Var("slot"))
                                    scan_call_e:
                                        subtract(Var("fuel"), Val(LitV(LitInt(1))))
                                        Var("start")
                                        add(Var("step"), Val(LitV(LitInt(1))))
                                        Var("cap")
                                        Var("tags")
                                        Var("keys")
                                        Var("vals")
                                        Var("k")
                                        Var("hole")
                            scan_call_e:
                                subtract(Var("fuel"), Val(LitV(LitInt(1))))
                                Var("start")
                                add(Var("step"), Val(LitV(LitInt(1))))
                                Var("cap")
                                Var("tags")
                                Var("keys")
                                Var("vals")
                                Var("k")
                                hole_or_e(Var("hole"), Var("slot"))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition scan_loop : expr :=
    If (BinOp LeOp (Var "fuel") (Val (LitV (LitInt 0))))
      (probe_done (Val (LitV (LitBool false)))
        (hole_or_e (Var "hole") (Var "start")) (Val (LitV (LitInt 0))))
      (Let (Some "slot") (probe_slot_e (Var "start") (Var "step") (Var "cap"))
        (Let (Some "tag") (arr_get (Var "tags") (Var "slot"))
          (If (BinOp EqOp (Var "tag") lit_tag_empty)
            (probe_done (Val (LitV (LitBool false)))
              (hole_or_e (Var "hole") (Var "slot")) (Val (LitV (LitInt 0))))
            (If (BinOp EqOp (Var "tag") lit_tag_occ)
              (Let (Some "key") (arr_get (Var "keys") (Var "slot"))
                (If (BinOp EqOp (Var "key") (Var "k"))
                  (probe_done (Val (LitV (LitBool true))) (Var "slot")
                    (arr_get (Var "vals") (Var "slot")))
                  (scan_call_e (Var "fuel" - Val (LitV (LitInt 1)))
                    (Var "start") (Var "step" + Val (LitV (LitInt 1)))
                    (Var "cap") (Var "tags") (Var "keys") (Var "vals")
                    (Var "k") (Var "hole"))))
              (scan_call_e (Var "fuel" - Val (LitV (LitInt 1)))
                (Var "start") (Var "step" + Val (LitV (LitInt 1)))
                (Var "cap") (Var "tags") (Var "keys") (Var "vals")
                (Var "k") (hole_or_e (Var "hole") (Var "slot"))))))).

lookup_loop_e

cjr.examples.hash_map.lookup_loop_e · hash_map

definition lookup_loop_e:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(step, type(expr))
    parameter(setstep, setres, type(arrow(expr, expr)))
    parameter(start, cap, tags, keys, vals, k, type(expr))
    type:
        expr
    body:
        while_loop:
            less_or_equal(add(step, zlit(1)), cap)
            let_binding:
                Some("s")
                step
                let_binding:
                    Some("slot")
                    probe_slot_e(start, Var("s"), cap)
                    let_binding:
                        Some("tag")
                        arr_get(tags, Var("slot"))
                        conditional:
                            BinOp(EqOp, Var("tag"), lit_tag_empty)
                            setstep(cap)
                            conditional:
                                BinOp(EqOp, Var("tag"), lit_tag_occ)
                                let_binding:
                                    Some("key")
                                    arr_get(keys, Var("slot"))
                                    conditional:
                                        BinOp(EqOp, Var("key"), k)
                                        sequence:
                                            setres:
                                                Struct:
                                                    empty_list
                                                    list_with_tail_items:
                                                        Val(LitV(LitBool(true)))
                                                        items(arr_get(vals, Var("slot")))
                                            setstep(cap)
                                        setstep(add(step, zlit(1)))
                                setstep(add(step, zlit(1)))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Definition lookup_loop_e (step : expr) (setstep setres : expr → expr)
    (start cap tags keys vals k : expr) : expr :=
  While (step + zlit 1 ≤ cap)
    (Let (Some "s") step
    (Let (Some "slot") (probe_slot_e start (Var "s") cap)
      (Let (Some "tag") (arr_get tags (Var "slot"))
        (If (BinOp EqOp (Var "tag") lit_tag_empty)
          (setstep cap)
          (If (BinOp EqOp (Var "tag") lit_tag_occ)
            (Let (Some "key") (arr_get keys (Var "slot"))
              (If (BinOp EqOp (Var "key") k)
                (Seq (setres (Struct [] [Val (LitV (LitBool true)); arr_get vals (Var "slot")]))
                  (setstep cap))
                (setstep (step + zlit 1))))
            (setstep (step + zlit 1))))))).

    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))

    parameter(vals, type(_ (inferred)))

    statement:
        arrow:
            wf_table(cap, tags, keys, vals)
            match RegularStyle:
                probe(cap, bucket(k, cap), tags, keys, vals, k)
                case:
                    patterns(PFound(i, v))
                    both:
                        in_scope nat(less_than(i, cap))
                        both:

                                equals(lookup(vals, i), Some(v))
                case:
                    patterns(PAbsent(i))
                    both:
                        in_scope nat(less_than(i, cap))
                        either:
                            equals(lookup(tags, i), Some(tag_empty))
                            equals(lookup(tags, i), Some(tag_tomb))

Lemma probe_slots cap tags keys vals k :
    wf_table cap tags keys vals →
    match probe cap (bucket k cap) tags keys vals k with
    | PFound i v => (i < cap)%nat ∧ tags !! i = Some tag_occ ∧
        keys !! i = Some k ∧ vals !! i = Some v
    | PAbsent i => (i < cap)%nat ∧
        (tags !! i = Some tag_empty ∨ tags !! i = Some tag_tomb)
    end.

    wf_table cap tags keys vals →
    is_array tags ta -∗ is_array keys ka -∗ is_array vals va -∗

Lemma head_drop_hm {A} (xs : list A) i x tail :
    drop i xs = x :: tail → xs !! i = Some x ∧ drop (S i) xs = tail.

Lemma rehash_spec tags :
    ∀ keys vals i st sk sv sta ska sva cap dt dk dv accT accK accV,
    drop i st = tags → drop i sk = keys → drop i sv = vals →
    length keys = length tags → length vals = length tags →
    tags_ok tags → NoDup (occ_keys tags keys) →
    wf_table cap accT accK accV →
    (∀ x, x ∈ occ_keys tags keys → contents_of accT accK accV !! x = None) →
    (2 * (count_occ accT + count_occ tags) ≤ cap)%nat →
    is_array st sta -∗ is_array sk ska -∗ is_array sv sva -∗
    is_array accT dt -∗ is_array accK dk -∗ is_array accV dv -∗
    WP call_rehash (length tags) i sta ska sva cap dt dk dv
      {{ r, let '(t2,k2,v2) := rehash_acc cap tags keys vals accT accK accV in
        ⌜r = LitV LitUnit⌝ ∗ is_array st sta ∗ is_array sk ska ∗ is_array sv sva ∗
        is_array t2 dt ∗ is_array k2 dk ∗ is_array v2 dv }}.

write_fresh_effect

cjr.examples.hash_map.write_fresh_effect · hash_map

lemma write_fresh_effect:
    context:
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(cjrGS(Σ)))
        typeclass maximal implicit !(_, type(invGS_gen(HasLc, Σ)))
    parameter(cap, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(tags, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(keys, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(vals, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(k, type(_ (inferred)))
    parameter(v, type(_ (inferred)))
    statement:
        arrow:
            wf_table(cap, tags, keys, vals)
            arrow:
                arrow:
                    equals(lookup(contents_of(tags, keys, vals), k), None)
                    in_scope nat(less_than(multiply(2, count_occ(tags)), cap))
                match LetPatternStyle:
                    write_fresh(cap, tags, keys, vals, k, v)
                    case:
                        patterns(tuple_with_tail_items(t2, items(k2, v2)))
                        both:
                            wf_table(cap, t2, k2, v2)
                            both:
                                equals:
                                    contents_of(t2, k2, v2)
                                    apply:
                                        notation "<[ _ := _ ]>":
                                            k
                                            v
                                        contents_of(tags, keys, vals)
                                equals:
                                    count_occ(t2)
                                    if_then_else:
                                        bool_decide:
                                            is_Some:
                                                lookup(contents_of(tags, keys, vals), k)
                                        count_occ(tags)
                                        S(count_occ(tags))
Original declaration (proof-free)
Lemma write_fresh_effect cap tags keys vals k v :
    wf_table cap tags keys vals →
    (contents_of tags keys vals !! k = None → (2 * count_occ tags < cap)%nat) →
    let '(t2,k2,v2) := write_fresh cap tags keys vals k v in
    wf_table cap t2 k2 v2 ∧
    contents_of t2 k2 v2 = <[k:=v]> (contents_of tags keys vals) ∧
    count_occ t2 = if bool_decide (is_Some (contents_of tags keys vals !! k))
                  then count_occ tags else S (count_occ tags).
